cases.title: Bind the single shared fixture
cases.expectation: Use editor profile and the existing prepareThemeEditorQaStore hook; retain gifts product/collection IDs and shipping-rate ID from actual receipts. Do not run a second seed harness.

cases.title: Install and publish Kindred v2
cases.expectation: Use actual merchant theme UI; record admitted package/release/hash, draft version, save/publish receipt and reload. Installation must not seed catalog content.

cases.title: Edit the existing gifts product
cases.expectation: Use normal merchant product page to add birthday/thank-you and friend/colleague to the existing gifts metadata, preserve three contents rows and images, save and reload with actual version/idempotency.

cases.title: Invalid media-role recovery
cases.expectation: Attempt an out-of-range role and a duplicated role through available merchant controls/API negative control; no durable mutation. Record actual validation stage/status.

cases.title: Unknown-facts recovery
cases.expectation: On the same product, temporarily omit contents and role bindings; no made-up contents, fulfillment or imagery. Restore actual saved base facts before purchase.

cases.title: Collection and search discovery
cases.expectation: Use actual admitted options and counts; occasion/recipient/budget/sort combinations on both routes, independent clear URLs, repeated unrelated connector preservation, true empty response and recovery. No fabricated option/count; source-only static QA is separate.

cases.title: PDP and supplied media
cases.expectation: Confirm Mug 300 ml/Hand wash., Notebook, Pen; open/closed images from explicit roles. Base fixture has no product options or variants, so no wrapping selector or variant identity may be invented.

cases.title: Keyboard and responsive browsing
cases.expectation: Capture actual installed 320/768/1440 layouts and focus/activation, including hydrated header/menu behavior; record outstanding long-brand header defect independently.

cases.title: Server cart and reload
cases.expectation: Add one existing gifts product, await canonical server response, reload same owned buyer/store cart: quantity 1, unit price 1100 INR, selected options empty, approved immutable gift facts and saved primary image.

cases.title: Client authority negative
cases.expectation: Attempt unsupported price/snapshot fields and allowed display-property spoof separately; record actual contract response and unchanged server price/contents/image. Do not assert a status that was not observed.

cases.title: Buyer identity
cases.expectation: Register/sign in through real identity UI, reload account, carry the actual store-scoped session into checkout; do not inject a minted session or copy public-demo identity.

cases.title: Hosted COD checkout
cases.expectation: Through actual hosted checkout choose Bengaluru Karnataka 560001 and the shared flat 20 INR rate, confirm COD. Expected server subtotal 1100, shipping 20, discount 0, tax 0, total 1120 INR; reconcile if server differs. COD pending must not appear paid.

cases.title: Idempotent retry
cases.expectation: Repeat the same accepted order command with its same actual idempotency key using the existing harness/control; exactly the same order, no duplicate line/reservation/link. Not a second UI purchase claim.

cases.title: Initial saved readback
cases.expectation: Record buyer account/order UI, merchant order UI and actual Liquid order detail from the accepted saved order. Facts, quantity, monetary totals and primary image match accepted order; raw/private product snapshot absent.

cases.title: Merchant mutation after purchase
cases.expectation: On the same product change Mug detail to 250 ml and reorder/remove the supplied images through normal save. Keep actual receipts. Current catalog changes; saved order keeps original 300 ml/care/contents and accepted primary image.

cases.title: Historical readback after mutation
cases.expectation: Reload all three saved readbacks. Exact old snapshot/primary image remains; unavailable historical facts stay unavailable and never fall back to current catalog.

cases.title: Stale cart review
cases.expectation: Keep a separate accepted cart before G15; later checkout must follow actual CART_FACTS_CHANGED/review contract, with no second unintended order/reservation.

cases.title: Tenant and buyer isolation
cases.expectation: Use owner-allocated Buyer B/foreign-site controls; refuse foreign cart token/order IDs and verify no private facts or raw snapshot leakage. Positive own-order control first.

cases.title: Conflict and resource recovery
cases.expectation: Exercise a stale merchant version without overwriting latest edit, then verify cleanup only for allocated run resources and publish a lease-release receipt.
